title: Hear the alphabet
goal: Follow the letters. Find their rhythm.

study.title: Get familiar with A to Z.
paragraphs: An alphabet song connects the names and order of the letters. Listen once while following the shapes, then join in when you feel ready.
You do not have to remember everything immediately. Return to a short section and repeat it until the sequence feels more familiar.

study.title: Try it in three steps.
paragraphs: First, watch and follow the letters. Next, sing or speak along. Then look away and see how much of the sequence you can recall.
If one group of letters runs together, slow your own repetition and give each letter a clear name. Go back to the letter board for any names you want to check.
items: Follow the shapes with your eyes.
Recall A to Z, then check the part you missed.
